title: meeting-template template variables
description: Values for templates/meeting-template.md.j2 and templates/meeting-template.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from meeting-template.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

action_item.title: Action item
action_item.description: What is the action? One concrete thing with an observable finish, not 'follow up on the discussion'.

due_date.description: By when is that action due, as YYYY-MM-DD? Before the next meeting, or it will be read out again unchanged.

meeting_date.title: Meeting date
meeting_date.description: On what date does this meeting happen, as YYYY-MM-DD? Not the same field as the action due date below, which is why they are two variables.

next_action_owner.description: Who owns the action coming out of this meeting? One named human who was in the room and agreed to it.

stakeholder_name.title: Stakeholder name
stakeholder_name.description: Which stakeholder is this meeting with? One named person - the agenda below assumes a conversation, not a broadcast.
